mintAuthority.headline: Two issuer-controlled native minters have uncapped issuance power; reserve reconciliation and independent signing controls remain undisclosed.
mintAuthority.summary: Two codeless EOAs hold native Etherlink MINTER_ROLE, and the default-admin EOA also controls the transparent proxy administrator. Native issuance has no reserve-gated numeric cap. MPC remains an issuer claim without disclosed signer independence or threshold. The additional adapter-only minter/burner and satellite representations are reviewed separately under Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: Fresh observations at Etherlink block 55662309 (2026-10-15T10:44:04Z), Ethereum 26197403 (2026-10-15T10:45:47Z), Base 52635906 and Arbitrum 515036195 (both 2026-10-15T10:45:59Z) confirm unchanged token implementations, default administrators and proxy owners. Complete indexed native MINTER_ROLE grant/revoke queries identify two current native EOAs and the adapter-only middleware; all three memberships are true, while former middleware 0x511879cd4cf5941c09b8c2e3d6be4d54a6befa07 was revoked at block 44157250 and is false. Native defaultAdmin, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and ProxyAdmin.owner identify 0x1bb0b2666edd827f74b558136fdbe69e4ecec5fd. Both native EOA eth_getCode reads return 0x. Full role-indexed event queries and pinned hasRole identify six active BURNER_ROLE holders: the two native minters, bridge middleware 0x28da1dfaf5dca1af226a2e56b834e8ec3c495c5a, 0xbd02a555180f03293982ab5384d8a505bb4f2a31, 0x1bd84f57611b610877292fe224d16369719e2845 and 0xef5031348a2f1ea8cbc8157bce255892c34971c9. The sole BLACKLIST_ROLE grant and current membership belong to the default administrator. Five active WHITELIST_ROLE holders are that administrator, 0x4a7148c0c0a18808075dff911b19e9aad5e6fe67, 0x36191a4f22ee5818cbf34364ca61274733798529, 0xbd02a555180f03293982ab5384d8a505bb4f2a31 and 0x1bd84f57611b610877292fe224d16369719e2845. All four roles have DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE as role administrator. Verified native burn destroys only msg.sender's balance; WHITELIST_ROLE is declared but does not gate mint or transfer in this implementation. Burner-only and unused whitelist memberships therefore do not create additional native mint paths. All four adapter owners and Endpoint.delegates return the same default-administrator EOA; all twelve peers match the official roster and all twenty-four effective send/receive ULNs require two DVNs with no optional DVNs. Send and receive libraries are explicit; all twelve receive-library timeout slots have zero address and expiry. Native verified receive checks endpoint and peer, and the self-only simulator always reverts. These are code and state observations, not financial reconciliation, independent signing assurance or runtime exploit tests. Prudential supervision follows the exact ESMA issuer/EMI row. MPC threshold, operator independence, recovery policy and independent whole-liability reconciliation remain undisclosed. Historical limitation: the October 5 accounting attempt at block 54935586 counted 17 RoleGranted, one RoleRevoked, two Upgraded events and 423 zero-sender Transfers totaling 43700256460391000000000000 base units against native supply 7059516402343000000000000; unfiltered Transfers truncated at 1000 and burn queries failed. That attempt did not establish complete mint/burn accounting or reserve reconciliation. Its stronger assertion that practical incidentState none was unsupported is superseded by the October 11 exact-control negative reviews i43apxusdb-usdsm-stable-mint-5951c00b5ef7965fec9f-20261011, i43apxusdb-usdsm-stable-mint-8ea62eea76364fb14c11-20261011 and i43apxusdb-usdsm-stable-mint-bbb3136e12def53ad156-20261011 in incident-reviews-v1.json. Those finite reviews cover March 10, 2025 through October 11, 2026 and establish only no known incident for each matching control, not lifetime incident absence, complete historical accounting or financial assurance. Native authority and economic semantics are now independently established; custody-only questions remain in scopedQuestions and financial reconciliation remains unknown in its dedicated field. Bridge validation/operator and runtime-execution limitations remain in the bridge review, not as unresolved native authority.
